principle: Generation 3 begins with competing scientific premises derived from the null map, not a large run.

C1_P1R_priority.prior_failure_addressed: P1R external replication null: per-item replay-value prediction did not yield a competitive replay policy
C1_P1R_priority.new_causal_premise: replay value is informative for HOW OFTEN to replay an item (a soft sampling priority over a representative buffer), not for WHICH items to KEEP; the keep decision should stay class-balanced (GDumb-like) while value modulates sampling
C1_P1R_priority.why_old_mechanism_could_not_express_it: the Gen2 P1R was a buffer-admission/eviction filter, so value biased the buffer toward hard/atypical exemplars and destabilized the shared head; it could not separate the keep decision from the replay-frequency decision
C1_P1R_priority.established_baseline_to_beat: GDumb (best established), reservoir, uniform, loss-sampling, class-balanced sampling
C1_P1R_priority.oracle_headroom_required: an oracle sampling priority over a fixed GDumb buffer must beat uniform GDumb sampling by SESOI
C1_P1R_priority.cheapest_falsification: measure whether ANY sampling priority (loss/oracle) over the fixed GDumb buffer beats uniform GDumb sampling; if not, no headroom

C2_V1_capable_family.prior_failure_addressed: V1 verification was architecture_dependent: real per-item value but only 1 of 3 capable estimators decoded it
C2_V1_capable_family.new_causal_premise: verification value is a downstream-decision quantity decodable by a sufficiently expressive estimator; the Gen2 architecture-dependence was an estimator-capacity artifact, not an absence of value
C2_V1_capable_family.why_old_mechanism_could_not_express_it: Gen2 admission judged architecture agreement over a fixed small capable set (knn, kernel_ridge, rff_ridge); it could not distinguish a capacity limit from a genuine architecture-dependence
C2_V1_capable_family.established_baseline_to_beat: raw uncertainty (U1 frozen negative), entropy, margin, loss; the always/never/random verify controls
C2_V1_capable_family.oracle_headroom_required: an expanded capable estimator family (add an MLP and higher-capacity RFF) must robustly decode the value in >=2 members beyond the best simple control
C2_V1_capable_family.cheapest_falsification: re-evaluate the existing V1 bed with the expanded family; if <2 members clear the group rule, no headroom

C3_S1_model_error_aware.prior_failure_addressed: S1 simulation was worse than random: learned-model rollout errors compounded over the horizon
C3_S1_model_error_aware.new_causal_premise: simulate only as deep as the estimated rollout error permits, and trust the simulated value in proportion to a calibrated model-error estimate; depth and trust are conditioned on estimated error
C3_S1_model_error_aware.why_old_mechanism_could_not_express_it: Gen2 S1 used a fixed-depth learned rollout with no error awareness, so compounding error dominated
C3_S1_model_error_aware.established_baseline_to_beat: reactive policy, one-step planner, direct predictor, matched-compute planner, and an oracle-model planner
C3_S1_model_error_aware.oracle_headroom_required: an oracle-model planner must beat reactive by SESOI (headroom exists), and error-aware depth must recover a fraction of that gap
C3_S1_model_error_aware.independent_units_required: distinct dynamical systems (gymnasium classic-control plus perturbations)
C3_S1_model_error_aware.cheapest_falsification: check that an oracle-model planner beats reactive; if not even a perfect model helps, no headroom (needs a new env harness with a calibrated error estimator, so gate 5 is not yet cheaply runnable)

C4_M1_causal_message.prior_failure_addressed: M1 messaging fired on predictable-but-noncausal items: message predictability is not causal message value
C4_M1_causal_message.new_causal_premise: estimate the INTERVENTION-level value of a message (the causal effect of delivering vs withholding it on the recipient decision), not its predictability
C4_M1_causal_message.why_old_mechanism_could_not_express_it: Gen2 M1 predicted per-item message benefit from the sender features but conflated predictability with causal value
C4_M1_causal_message.established_baseline_to_beat: no-message, concatenated features, and a centralized matched-capacity model
C4_M1_causal_message.oracle_headroom_required: an oracle causal-message value (measured by counterfactual delivery) must beat a centralized matched-capacity control
C4_M1_causal_message.independent_units_required: genuine multi-view or multi-agent tasks with disjoint views
C4_M1_causal_message.cheapest_falsification: construct a counterfactual-delivery oracle; if it does not beat the centralized control, no headroom (needs a genuine causal multi-view bed)

C5_E1_relational_roles.prior_failure_addressed: E1 event boundaries did not beat simple change detectors: relational structure was not captured
C5_E1_relational_roles.new_causal_premise: model temporal ROLE changes and relations between entities (not local novelty); a boundary marks a change in the relational configuration, not a magnitude change
C5_E1_relational_roles.why_old_mechanism_could_not_express_it: Gen2 E1 used a relational transition surprise that still reduced to a per-frame novelty signal
C5_E1_relational_roles.established_baseline_to_beat: fixed windows, novelty, prediction-error, and change-point detectors
C5_E1_relational_roles.oracle_headroom_required: an oracle relational-boundary set must improve downstream value beyond the best change detector by SESOI on a task where relations, not magnitudes, define events
C5_E1_relational_roles.independent_units_required: sessions with genuine relational structure (multi-entity streams)
C5_E1_relational_roles.cheapest_falsification: build a multi-entity stream where change detectors provably fail; if oracle relational boundaries do not beat them, no headroom (needs a new relational bed)

selection_rationale: C1 and C2 were the two candidates with cheaply measurable gate-5 headroom on existing beds. Selection is CONDITIONED on that measurement: only a candidate whose cheap precompute shows headroom is selected for implementation. A no_headroom verdict falsifies the candidate at the gate, exactly as intended. C3 (model-error-aware simulation) is the highest-novelty candidate but its gate-5 needs a new gym-with-error harness, so it is deferred as the immediate next thesis to build.
deferred_but_ranked: C3_S1_model_error_aware (highest novelty; build the error-aware gym harness next)

C1_P1R_priority.1_causal_hypothesis: Using predicted replay value as a soft sampling priority over a fixed class-balanced (GDumb) buffer improves final retention beyond uniform GDumb sampling under matched memory and compute.
C1_P1R_priority.2_null: Value-weighted sampling over the GDumb buffer does not beat uniform GDumb sampling (a tie is a null).
C1_P1R_priority.3_strongest_established_method: GDumb (uniform sampling over a class-balanced buffer); also reservoir, uniform, loss-sampling.
C1_P1R_priority.4_oracle: An oracle sampling priority that weights each buffer item by its true retention benefit (measured reduction in end-of-stream forgetting).
C1_P1R_priority.6_controls: positive control: oracle priority should beat uniform; negative control: random priority must not beat uniform; shuffled-priority must not beat uniform.
C1_P1R_priority.7_power_analysis: with per-task retention units and 5 seeds, min detectable effect approx 0.05 at SESOI 0.05; scale seeds until the CI half-width < SESOI.
C1_P1R_priority.8_independent_units: class-incremental tasks (retention), across seeds; report per-task seed-averaged effects.
C1_P1R_priority.9_cheapest_falsification: measure whether ANY sampling priority (loss/oracle) over the fixed GDumb buffer beats uniform GDumb sampling; if not, no headroom

C2_V1_capable_family.1_causal_hypothesis: Verification value is decodable by a sufficiently expressive estimator family; an expanded capable family robustly decodes it beyond the best simple uncertainty control.
C2_V1_capable_family.2_null: No expanded-family gain: fewer than two capable estimators clear the group rule (a tie is a null).
C2_V1_capable_family.3_strongest_established_method: raw uncertainty / entropy / margin / loss (the U1 frozen negative) and always/never/random verify.
C2_V1_capable_family.4_oracle: the measured verification-decision gain (base wrong and verifier correct) per item.
C2_V1_capable_family.5_residual_oracle_headroom: no_headroom (0 of family clear the group rule; per-estimator lcb {'mlp': -0.066, 'knn': -0.051, 'kernel_ridge': -0.023, 'rff_ridge': -0.034})
C2_V1_capable_family.6_controls: positive: kernel_ridge (the Gen2 passer) must still pass; negative: shuffled-target and rate-matched-random must fail.
C2_V1_capable_family.7_power_analysis: 6 regimes as units; min detectable effect approx 0.06; add regimes or seeds if the family lcb straddles SESOI.
C2_V1_capable_family.9_cheapest_falsification: re-evaluate the existing V1 bed with the expanded family; if <2 members clear the group rule, no headroom

C2_V1_capable_family.interpretation: 0 of 4 capable estimators robustly decode verification value beyond the best simple control

C1_P1R_priority.interpretation: a replay-sampling priority over the fixed GDumb buffer does beat uniform GDumb sampling

mandatory_admission_clauses: every candidate must additionally satisfy the null-derived constraints (MOP_NULL_DERIVED_CONSTRAINTS.json).
